question: How often do people dismiss or tap the mobile app-version update prompt, per namespace and build? Upgrade Modal Dismissed and Upgrade Modal Clicked are that store-update dialog (app/lib/widgets/upgrade_alert.dart), not the subscription paywall. The registry forbids renaming these released wire names. Do not use them in paywall, upgrade, ARPMAU, or churn queries.
zero_policy: Zero events is expected when the update prompt is not shown for the selected namespace and build. Absence is not a subscription-funnel failure.
